name: call
doc: the decode step's contract, the facts that do not depend on the depth: every (d_v, decay) FSLA accepts and the extent the step is sized by (`batch_heads`). A list is alternatives, each its own context; a range is one context. d_v is a range because the seam pads any value width up to the arm that serves it (decode's launch function maps d_v into the arm's, common/plan/decode_launch.h). The depth and the level widths are a depth part's (depth1 .. depth4), composed beside this one.

d_v.declared_by: docs/internals/common/plan/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the value widths a decode arm serves, 2 up to its widest arm; fsla/_state.py's StateFormat admits an even width from 2

decay.declared_by: docs/internals/common/plan/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the recurrence either decays (1) or not (0)

batch_heads.declared_by: docs/api.md#batch-heads: a decode step serves B times H from 1 to 536870911, within what the step's work queue indexes (csrc/fsla/src/decode/decode.cu: `int BH` and the queue of 3 B H + 2 int32 counters)
